basic_details.job_title: Anna University Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Centre for Environmental Studies (CES), Anna University, Chennai has invited applications for 1 temporary Project Assistant post under the Chief Minister's Research Grant (CMRG) titled "Exposure Assessment of Fine and Ultrafine Particles Due to Biomining Operations of Legacy Waste and its Health Risk Assessment". Eligible candidates must submit their applications through post or in person to the Professor and Director, Centre for Environmental Studies, Anna University, Chennai 600 025 on or before 22.10.2026.

how_to_apply: Download the application form from the official notification PDF.
Fill in all details of your academic qualification documents and experience.
Mention your email ID, contact number, and complete postal address in your application.
Attach copies of your academic qualification documents and experience certificates.
Submit the completed application through post or in person to the Professor and Director, Centre for Environmental Studies, Anna University, Chennai 600 025 on or before 22.10.2026.
important_instructions: The post is purely on a temporary basis. Selected candidates must be willing to register for Ph.D in the project. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing for the interview.

content_sections.heading: Anna University Project Assistant at a Glance

rows.details: Centre for Environmental Studies, CEG campus, Anna University, Chennai - 600025
Exposure Assessment of Fine and Ultrafine Particles Due to Biomining Operations of Legacy Waste and its Health Risk Assessment
Temporary for 26 months or end of the project period whichever is earlier

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess the required educational qualifications to be eligible for the Project Assistant post.

rows.essential_qualification: M.E or M.Tech Engineering / Environmental Management / Environmental Science / M.Sc Chemistry / M.Tech Chemical Engineering / M.Tech Industrial Safety and Hazards Management / M.Tech Environmental Science & Technology / Master of Public Health (MPH) and willingness to register for Ph.D in the project.
rows.desirable: PG Degree in the above specialization will be highly desirable.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Anna University Project Assistant
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the official notification PDF. Fill in all details of your academic qualification documents and experience. Mention your email ID, contact number, and complete postal address in your application. Attach copies of your academic qualification documents and experience certificates. Submit the completed application through post or in person to the Professor and Director, Centre for Environmental Studies, Anna University, Chennai 600 025 on or before 22.10.2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Short-listed candidates will be called for an interview and selection will be based on interview. If the interview committee finds no suitable candidate in the advertised specialization, they may have the discretion to consider candidates with closely related specializations if applied.

content_sections.text: The post is purely on a temporary basis. Selected candidates must be willing to register for Ph.D in the project. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing for the interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to submit the application for Anna University Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application is 22.10.2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Project Assistant post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the consolidated salary for the Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary is Rs.25,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential qualification required for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an M.E or M.Tech in relevant engineering or science disciplines, M.Sc Chemistry, Master of Public Health (MPH), and must be willing to register for Ph.D in the project.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline through post or in person.

faq.question: Q6. Where should the application be sent?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent to the Professor and Director, Centre for Environmental Studies, Anna University, Chennai 600 025.

faq.question: Q7. Is there an application fee mentioned in the notification?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this post?
faq.answer: Selection is based on an interview of short-listed candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Is the Project Assistant position permanent?
faq.answer: No, the post is purely on a temporary basis for 26 months or until the end of the project period whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q10. Are travel allowances provided for the interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA will be paid for appearing for the interview.
